summary.intent: Continue a multi-workstream cleanup in the wisp-plugins repo (review-slop-evaluation worktree): finish WS1 (removing 'connect mode' references) and implement WS2 (verification rules updates).
summary.outcome: WS1 was committed (d24be9e0) after a contradiction sweep found and fixed one leftover 'connect mode' mention in the weaver README. WS2 rule edits were applied via a script, a new fix-pass fixtures test was written, Codex output was regenerated and checks were run, but the results are not shown in the transcript.

repo: Work is done in a git worktree at wisp-plugins/.claude/worktrees/review-slop-evaluation.
Rule/language files have a generated Codex output that must be regenerated after editing source rules.
A 'contradiction sweep' (grep for stale terminology) is run before committing each workstream and catches leftover references in READMEs.
Verification language files can contain duplicate hazard content, so they are read before editing to avoid duplication.

code.finding: New test file added in WS2 to cover fix-pass fixtures.

workflow: Run a contradiction/terminology sweep before committing a workstream to catch stale references.
Bulk rule edits were done through a throwaway script (ws2.py in a jobs tmp dir) kept outside the repo, then followed by regenerating derived output and running all checks in one step.
Track workstreams with TaskUpdate to mark progress between commits.
